title: Adaptability to Shifting Requirements
question: Describe a scenario where project requirements or technologies changed dramatically mid-way through development. How did you adapt?

rubric.name: situation_context
rubric.description: Explains initial setup, nature of the shift, and immediate technical impact.

rubric.name: mindset_adaptability
rubric.description: Demonstrates constructive attitude, agility, and openness to change.

rubric.name: technical_pivot_action
rubric.description: Outlines concrete actions to re-architect, re-plan, or quickly learn new concepts.

rubric.name: delivery_impact
rubric.description: Delivers a functional solution despite shifting constraints.

rubric.name: reflection
rubric.description: Identifies lessons on modular software design for future change.

expected_signals: Quickly assesses impact on existing codebase and schedule
Embraces learning new tools or paradigms productively
Maintains momentum and positive team attitude
red_flags: Complains excessively about changing business needs
Resists technical pivots due to attachment to legacy work
Fails to deliver anything functional after requirement change
follow_up_prompts: How did you restructure your code or architecture to accommodate the new direction efficiently?
What steps did you take to ramp up on unfamiliar tools or frameworks under time pressure?
